snippet.title: Nightmare Shift | XBOX Trailer
snippet.description:
🔦 They say the walls have ears... but what if the walls have eyes? https://www.xbox.com/games/store/nightmare-shift/9nqvph0hh666

Check out Nightmare Shift, arriving on XBOX Series X|S on July 30, 2026!

Step into Emma's life, where ordinary nights unravel into extraordinary mysteries. Take on night shifts at a remote motel, handle unsettling guests, and navigate eerie events as the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Explore the motel and Emma's apartment, solve puzzles, and question what's real, while your choices lead to multiple endings. An atmospheric, photo-realistic psychological horror that will drive you insane.
